qs.q: Which is NOT a class of drugs used in HIV/AIDS therapy?
qs.e: Ribozyme inhibitors are NOT an established class of HIV drugs. The recognized classes of antiretrovirals include NRTIs, NNRTIs, protease inhibitors, integrase inhibitors, fusion inhibitors, and CCR5 antagonists.
